text:
alex: Heads-up: planning a lightweight deploy for runtime config v3.5 to prod at 18:30 PT. Small change (KV cache sizing) but want quick sign-offs and smoke owners.
mira: acked for timeline. I can own smoke checks (18:35 start).
jordan: I can be rollback owner. rollback playbook is updated: https://confluence.redwood/rollbacks/v3-5
samira: quick QA spot-checks ok from my side, will run the embedding regression set.
alex: checklist (please reply with ✅ when done):
 - prod migration DB flag toggled? (`db.flag.kv_cache = true`)
 - infra autoscaler config validated
 - canary lane 1% enabled
 - monitoring dashboards for kv cache hit rate present
 - rollback route tested

mira: db flag is staged, will toggle at 18:28. ✅
jordan: autoscaler validated against expected qps spike, added slack alert on slow scale. ✅
chris: canary lane 1% deploy scheduled, deploy-bot will post status.
deploy-bot: [deploy] started canary rollout for runtime:v3.5 -> lane:canary-1pct (job id: dpl-78312)
alex: when canary hits 100 requests and no errors for 3m, proceed to gradual ramp. mira you'll start smoke then.
mira: running smoke now. command: ```curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/run-smoke -d '{"test":"kv_basic"}' | jq .```
mira: smoke results: 22/22 passing, p50 latency 42ms, kv_hit 92% :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: watching infra metrics. memory/latency stable. alert thresholds green.
jordan: rollback route sanity check: `kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=runtime:v3.4-rollback-test` in staging -> confirmed works. ✅
alex: approvals: @mira (smoke owner) ✅, @jordan (rollback) ✅, @samira (QA) ✅. anyone object to full rollout?
samira: no objections from QA. regression diff below threshold. ✅
chris: deploy-bot: promote canary -> lane:production-batch-1
deploy-bot: [deploy] promoted canary to production batch 1 (dpl-78312 -> batch-1). streaming logs at https://deploys.redwood/logs/dpl-78312
alex: monitor for 10m, if no regressions we'll continue ramp. if error rate >0.5% for 5m we abort and jordan triggers rollback.
mira: monitoring nominal at 5m. p95 latency +2ms. ✅
sre-oncall: added temporary 10m higher frequency sampling for kv_hit metric.
chris: all good from ops. continuing to ramp to 50% over 20m.
alex: final: thanks all. leaving this thread open for 30m then archiving. :party-parrot:
